messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem. We saw a cross-region retry spike tied to TLS handshakes + conntrack pressure. Need owners and short timelines.

maria: I'll own route-change debounce + lightweight prefix-cache audit. Plan: 150-250ms debounce, emit metrics. Due Thu 2026-03-26.

alex: I can do conntrack emergency change today (hashsize + gc) and run a k6 long-tail test. Hotfix canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

raj: I'll add cert-fallback logic for the handshake failures we saw and wire an alert when fallback >0.1%. Aim to have canary ready Fri.

jen: I'll coordinate deployment windows and add rollback docs. Also adding alerts: TLS handshake err rate >0.5%, conntrack >85%.

ops_oncall: Snippets from logs:
[2026-03-25T02:12:09Z] LB tls: handshake timeout client=10.8.2.9
[2026-03-25T02:12:10Z] conntrack: table full, insert failed id=12345
Route-change surge correlated with SDK retries.

sam: ops, please add pcap playbook link and scheduled query for cross-region retry spikes (10m window) posting weekly digest.

ops_oncall: Playbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident/playbooks/pcap-capture
Scheduled query `cross_region.retry_spike` added, digest -> #incidents-weekly.

deploy-bot: Detected PR alex/conntrack-hotfix. CI green. Deploy started by jen. ETA ~ 22m. :rocket:

maria: Will add metrics `route.debounce.count` and `route.change.rate` and small smoke test for rollout.

jen: Tracker created and maintaining. Links posted when live.

sam: Thanks. We'll review progress in Monday retro. Reopen thread if regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
